evals.prompt: Add a Toast / notification snackbar component to the design system. It's a small notification bar that slides in from the bottom-right, with variants for success (green), error (red), and info (cyan). Auto-dismiss after a few seconds.
evals.expected_output: A complete Toast component: .ds-toast CSS, a React wrapper, a barrel export, and a Storybook story covering all variants.

assertions.description: shared/components.css contains a .ds-toast block with a comment header and variant rules
CSS uses var(--token) references (at least 3); no hardcoded colors/spacing/radii
web/src/components/Toast.tsx exists — a thin wrapper that renders the .ds-toast classes and owns no visual values
Variants are a typed prop union mapped via a VARIANT_CLASS record; spreads ...rest and merges className
web/src/components/index.ts exports the component AND its prop types
web/src/components/Toast.stories.tsx exists with title 'Components/Toast'
Story has one export per variant/state plus an AllVariants overview render
Component JSDoc (or story docs description) includes an Avalonia mapping note
Interactive affordances forward ARIA / have focus-visible; status conveyed by more than color

evals.prompt: We have an existing .ds-progress-bar in components.css but no React wrapper or Storybook story for it yet. Add them so it's usable in the web app and shows in the catalog.
evals.expected_output: A React wrapper + barrel export + Storybook story for the existing CSS. No CSS changes needed.

assertions.description: Reads the existing .ds-progress-bar CSS; does not rewrite it unless a real gap exists
web/src/components/ProgressBar.tsx renders the existing .ds-progress-bar classes; props match what the CSS actually supports
Wrapper props/variants correspond to real classes/modifiers present in components.css (no invented variants)
web/src/components/index.ts exports the component AND its prop types
web/src/components/ProgressBar.stories.tsx exists with title 'Components/ProgressBar' and shows representative states
Component JSDoc (or story docs description) includes an Avalonia mapping note

evals.prompt: Add a new `device` variant to the existing Card component.
evals.expected_output: Targeted update: new .device CSS rule, extended wrapper variant union + VARIANT_CLASS, and the variant added to the existing story.

assertions.description: shared/components.css gets the new variant rule next to the existing Card component, using tokens
web/src/components/Card.tsx extends the variant union type and VARIANT_CLASS map; does not restructure the component
Card.stories.tsx adds a per-variant story export and includes the new variant in the AllVariants render
Existing files are edited surgically — no wholesale rewrite, no duplicated component
Any new CSS uses var(--token) references; no hardcoded values
